artworks.title: Neptune and Amphitrite
artworks.description: Gossaert's Gemäldegalerie panel crowns Poseidon and Amphitrite as a Renaissance sea-couple — shell, trident, and nude majesty standing for the ocean's royal household.

artworks.title: Amphitrite
artworks.description: Coysevox's marble Amphitrite in the Louvre rides a dolphin-borne wave — Poseidon's queen as French Baroque allegory of the sea's calm power.

artworks.title: Amphitrite
artworks.description: A bronze Amphitrite on the Place de la Marine in Agde, France — Poseidon's queen as the Mediterranean's local sea goddess, facing the harbour.

popCulture.title: 29 Amphitrite
popCulture.description: A large main-belt asteroid took Poseidon's queen's name — Amphitrite among the rocks between Mars and Jupiter.

popCulture.title: Amphitrite
popCulture.description: Amphitrite survives as the poetic name for the sea's calm sovereignty — Poseidon's consort who stills the waves she rules.
